# Páramo

> Your AI transformation partner. Páramo puts AI to work inside growing companies, then makes sure their teams can run it.

Páramo is an AI implementation partner based in the Twin Cities (Minneapolis and St. Paul, Minnesota), founded by brothers Dennis Morales (CEO) and Adrian Morales (COO). We work with growing companies whose teams are ready for AI: we find the work that should not need a person, build systems on the tools a company already uses, and train the team to own them. Official partner of OpenAI, DevRev and Jotform.

## What we do

- [AI Concierge](https://paramo.sh/what-we-do/): side-by-side help for owners and CEOs, setting up Claude for the way they work and building agentic workflows together.
- [Team AI Workshops](https://paramo.sh/what-we-do/): hands-on sessions in plain language, built around the tasks a team actually does.
- [AI Strategy](https://paramo.sh/what-we-do/): a map of where hours and money go, and a ranked plan of what to automate now, what can wait, and what to leave alone.
- [Fractional Chief AI Officer](https://paramo.sh/what-we-do/): part-time senior AI leadership: roadmap, tool and vendor decisions, an AI use policy, training, and a monthly leadership meeting.
- [Managed Agents](https://paramo.sh/what-we-do/): AI agents built on a company's own tools, which we monitor, maintain and improve.

## How we work

1. Audit: we sit with the people doing the work and find the work that should not need them.
2. Optimize: we fix the process, then build systems connected to the tools the team already uses.
3. Automate: we run it alongside the team until it runs on its own. Client-facing messages stay human-approved until the client chooses otherwise.
